learnerTasks.prompt: Point P(2, -4) is translated by the rule (x, y) → (x + 7, y − 5). Give the image P′.
Reflect the point (5, -2) across the x-axis. Give the image.
Rotate the point (7, 3) counterclockwise about the origin by 270°. Give the image.
A regular polygon has 8 sides. How many rotations about its centre, strictly between 0° and 360°, carry it onto itself, and what is the smallest such angle?

Triangle ABC has vertices A(-2, -4) and B(-4, 2). After a transformation the images are A′(2, 4) and B′(4, -2), and the triangle keeps its size and orientation sense. Which single rigid motion describes this?
Point P(4, 2) is translated by the rule (x, y) → (x + 7, y − 4). Give the image P′.
Reflect the point (10, 8) across the line y = x. Give the image.
Rotate the point (-7, -9) counterclockwise about the origin by 270°. Give the image.
A regular polygon has 11 sides. How many rotations about its centre, strictly between 0° and 360°, carry it onto itself, and what is the smallest such angle?

Triangle ABC has vertices A(7, 6) and B(6, -7). After a transformation the images are A′(-7, -6) and B′(-6, 7), and the triangle keeps its size and orientation sense. Which single rigid motion describes this?
Point P(-9, -10) is translated by the rule (x, y) → (x − 12, y + 8). Give the image P′.
Reflect the point (-6, 2) across the x-axis. Give the image.
